summary: Click Holdings Ltd., a BVI foreign private issuer listed on a US exchange, filed a Form 6-K on September 15, 2026 disclosing an Equity Purchase Agreement dated September 14, 2026 with Crom Structured Opportunities Fund I, LP, a Delaware limited partnership. The company may sell up to $100 million of Class A ordinary shares over a 36-month commitment period, at its sole discretion, via Advance Notices priced at 90% of VWAP. Minimum advance $15,000; maximum the lesser of $1,000,000 or Average Daily Trading Value. A Registration Rights Agreement requires an SEC registration statement within 30 calendar days. This US-equivalent equity line of credit creates potential dilution and share overhang; monitor pricing floor, ATM-style utilization, and registration effectiveness as the arbitrage angles.
